v0.1.1.description:
This is what changed from version 0.1.0:
- Fixed logic: Otome's Resolution now correctly requires Shigemichi

You can check the Client changes [here](https://github.com/Mat8071/Gnosia-AP-Client/releases/tag/v0.1.1).
v0.1.1.title: v0.1.1

v0.1.2.description:
Changes from 0.1.1:
- Logic Change: The rule that determines whether the player has event search is now more accurate (some event access logic makes use of it in certain cases)
- Fixed Logic: All events that require the player to be Gnosia with someone else now require the correct amount of crew members for the number of Gnosia to be settable to the correct amount (Previously, this was true only for some of them)
- Fixed Logic: the location "Learn About Let's Collaborate" now specifically requires at least 8 crew members since it's only obtainable on the night of day 2 at the earliest
- Some general code cleanup and improvements

You can check the Client changes [here](https://github.com/Mat8071/Gnosia-AP-Client/releases/tag/v0.1.2)
v0.1.2.title: v0.1.2

v0.1.3.description:
Changes from 0.1.2:

- Fixed Logic: `SQ Note 2 - Result Event Ver.` now also requires 7 crew members, meaning SQ Note 2 and Remnan Note 3 always require at least 7 crew members
v0.1.3.title: v0.1.3

v0.1.4.description:
Changes from 0.1.3:
- The logic system was completely rewritten. On top of making future development easier, rules are now also separated into "hard" and "soft" logic, allowing Universal Tracker to show locations that could be reached out of (soft) logic
- Added soft logic for events that require certain characters to detect lies (now they require either the Engineer Role, the Doctor Role, or the Say You're Human Skill)
- Added soft logic for the "Game Sermon" event (now it requires the Step Forward Skill)
- Added soft logic for Learn About Jonas 7 & Learn About Kukrushka 6 (now they require having at least 8 characters, counting the Player, so you don't need to rely on failed attacks or vote ties to get all characters to Night 3)
v0.1.4.title: v0.1.4

v0.2.0-beta.1.description:
First beta for v0.2.0

Note: This version of the AP World is _**NOT**_ compatible with `0.1.x` versions of the client and may also not be compatible with future `0.2.0` betas or the final release

## New Features
- Added many yaml options, among which a new goal and many optional locations that aren't based on events
- Universal Tracker Yaml-less support
- Universal Tracker will attempt to check the version of the ap world used in generation and the ap world used for tracking and error out if it finds a mismatch
### Bugfixes
- Generation is now 100% deterministic, so generating a multiworld with the same seed will always produce the exact same results
v0.2.0-beta.1.title: v0.2.0-beta.1
